sessions.value:
# Talking about success and failure

## A Success

Notice the collocations for talking about success in this schoolboy’s end-of-term report.

**SCHOOL REPORT**

| Subject   | Report                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| MATHS     | James has **made a breakthrough** in his maths this year, doing excellent work in comparison with last year. A **remarkable achievement**.                                                                                                                         |
| ENGLISH   | This year has seen a **dramatic improvement** in James’s English. His **crowning achievement** was his performance in the school production of _Othello_.                                                                                                          |
| FRENCH    | James has an **excellent grasp** of French. This will **come in useful** for the school trip to France next year, and we hope he will **take advantage** of the opportunities to speak French there.                                                               |
| SCIENCE   | James has done very well this year, **passing his exams** without any problems. If he continues to work hard, his **success next year is guaranteed**.                                                                                                             |
| GEOGRAPHY | James has **made good progress** with his geography this year, **gaining good marks** in the end-of-year exam.                                                                                                                                                     |
| HISTORY   | James’s history project was a **great success**. His use of original sources was **highly effective**. He **makes useful contributions** in class and **has the ability to explain** difficult ideas clearly to less able pupils.                                  |
| ART       | James found some **effective ways** of working with natural materials this year and his self-portrait was a **brilliant success**.                                                                                                                                 |
| SPORT     | James has been training hard and, as a member of the First Football Team, is now able to **enjoy the fruits of his hard work**. Playing for the school has certainly **brought out the best** in him and he has rightly **won the respect** of all his team-mates. |

sessions.value:
# Talking about success and failure

## B Failure

Notice the collocations relating to failure in these extracts from a newspaper called _Today’s Bad News_.

- Unfortunately the peace talks now seem likely to **fail miserably**. [be totally unsuccessful]
- Although a lot of money was invested in the film it has proved to be a **spectacular failure**. [extremely unsuccessful]
- O’Connor’s first play was a great success but his second **play flopped**. [failed to attract audiences]
- Hopes that the play would enjoy a long run in London were **dashed**. [hopes have had to be abandoned]
- Unfortunately, more pupils than ever are said to be **failing their final exams**.
- The mountaineer’s attempt to climb Mt Everest went **badly wrong**.
- Everyone agrees that the peace talks are **doomed to failure**. [are certain to fail]
- Hopes were initially high for the new project but it has proved to be a **dismal failure**. [a total failure]
- A couple of major companies in the area **went out of business** last month. [stopped doing business]
- I think the new plans for cutting railway costs are a **recipe for disaster**. [will certainly lead to major problems]
- At the last moment the Olympic ski jumper **lost his nerve** and did not take part in the competition. [was not brave enough]
- The President’s speech was disappointing as it **totally missed the point**. [failed to understand what is really important]

senses.definition_vi: Đạt được một bước đột phá quan trọng trong một lĩnh vực nào đó, đặc biệt là khoa học hoặc kỹ thuật.
examples: James has made a breakthrough in his maths this year.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng để chỉ sự tiến bộ đáng kể, vượt qua khó khăn hoặc đạt được kết quả bất ngờ.

use_prompts.question: How can students suddenly get much better at a difficult subject?
What medical discoveries would you most like to see in the future?

paraphrase.model: After months of practice, she made a breakthrough in algebra.

paraphrase.source: Researchers have finally found an important new way to treat the disease.
paraphrase.model: Researchers have finally made a breakthrough in treating the disease.

senses.definition_vi: Một thành tựu đáng chú ý, đặc biệt và gây ấn tượng.

senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để khen ngợi một thành công lớn hoặc một việc làm phi thường.

use_prompts.question: What do you think is humanity's most impressive success in science?

paraphrase.source: Finishing the bridge in only one year was really impressive.
paraphrase.model: Finishing the bridge in only one year was a remarkable achievement.

paraphrase.source: Learning three languages before the age of ten is an amazing success.
paraphrase.model: Learning three languages before the age of ten is a remarkable achievement.

senses.definition_vi: Sự cải thiện rõ rệt, đáng kể và nhanh chóng.

What would you like to be the greatest success of your career?

paraphrase.model: The cathedral was the architect's crowning achievement.

paraphrase.source: Winning the world title was the best moment of her sporting career.
paraphrase.model: Winning the world title was the crowning achievement of her sporting career.

image.value: a hand firmly holding a concept or object

senses.definition_vi: Sự hiểu biết sâu sắc và thành thạo về một vấn đề, kỹ năng hoặc ngôn ngữ.

use_prompts.question: What skills does a good maths teacher need?

image.value: a tool being used for a task

senses.definition_vi: Trở nên hữu ích, có ích trong một tình huống hoặc hoàn cảnh cụ thể.

senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả sự hữu dụng hoặc lợi ích mà một thứ gì đó mang lại.

use_prompts.question: Which school subjects help people most in everyday life?

senses.definition_vi: Đạt điểm đủ để đỗ trong một kỳ thi.
